FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 108
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Public Safety
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 108 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama National Guard
Education Assistance Program (ANGEAP) by an undetermined amount to provide tuition
assistance for: (1) accredited and non-accredited but approved certification or stand-alone
training as part of a workforce development program; and (2) the per term costs of required
on-campus living expenses and meal plans.
Additionally, this bill would cap payments for tuition, fees, ancillary costs, andper term cost of
required on-campus living expenses and meal plans at an amount not to exceed the median cost
of tuition per term of all public four-year institutions of higher education in the state. For the
2025-26 school year the median cost of tuition per term is $12,454.
